europe_now.title: Russian military helicopter breaches Polish airspace
europe_now.summary: Polish authorities scrambled fighter jets after a Russian Mi-8 helicopter crossed into the country's airspace from Kaliningrad. The incident prompted immediate security measures and heightened defense readiness along the eastern European border.

sources.headline: Poland scrambles jets after Russian helicopter breaches its airspace

europe_now.title: Intense Russian airstrikes target Ukrainian capital
europe_now.summary: Russian forces conducted a prolonged all-day bombing campaign across Kyiv, causing significant damage and raising alarms among international partners. The heavy assault comes as Ukrainian leadership continues to press global allies for enhanced air defense capabilities.

sources.headline: Russia launches all-day bombing attack on Kyiv
Zelenskyy set to address UN as Russia strikes Kyiv

top_stories.title: Slovak Prime Minister's NATO Comments Spark Scrutiny
top_stories.summary: Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico has drawn significant criticism and questions regarding his nation's commitments following controversial remarks concerning NATO's Article 5. The statements have triggered extensive alliance scrutiny over regional security solidarity.

sources.headline: Slovakia: PM Robert Fico's NATO Article 5 remarks spark criticism and raise questions about his country's NATO commitment

top_stories.title: Diplomatic Exchanges Following Sanctions and Pardons
top_stories.summary: Azerbaijan has pardoned a French citizen following the European Union's decision to lift specific sanctions involving a Russian billionaire. The diplomatic development connects recent shifts in international restrictive measures with bilateral releases.
